hero.filename: Oakhill Cemetery Mariposa War Skeane S Skeenes Grave Marker.jpg
hero.caption: Skeane S. Skeenes (1851) grave marker in the Oakhill Cemetery. Skeenes was the first militia member to be killed in action in the conflict between white settlers and Native Californians that became known as the Mariposa War. He was buried near the battlefield by his comrades and moved to this site in nearby Oakhurst, California in 1970.
